title: Writing Your Own Learning Profile
text: This capstone checks that you understand how a learner profile works and can design one, with a learning path, for something new.

tasks.text: Which of these rules is scaffolding, meant to be removed later, rather than a lasting habit?
choices: Keep secrets out of the code
Use for loops with an index, not forEach
Dry-run anything that sends or deletes

tasks.text: Which rule made the book's approach work, and was missing from the assistant's draft Python profile?
choices: Explain new syntax the first time you use it
Use only what I know, and tell me when a task needs something new instead of using it

tasks.text: Name the five kinds of change your learner profile went through, with one example of each.
tasks.answer: Knowledge grew (e.g. arrays added); environments changed (e.g. Apps Script to web pages); scaffolding came off (e.g. one-function rule removed in Functions); rules were corrected (e.g. semicolons only in JavaScript); habits accumulated (e.g. dry runs, pinned versions).

tasks.text: Why should a learner profile eventually be rewritten and shortened, rather than only added to?
tasks.answer: It grows too long to paste and read; parts stop being true ("I'm a beginner"); a huge list of known concepts is less useful than a summary. Keeping the lasting habits and summarizing knowledge makes it accurate and practical.

tasks.text: Capstone. Choose a platform, language or skill you haven't learned. Submit: (1) a learner profile for it, with each rule marked as scaffolding (and when you'd remove it) or as a habit, including a "use only what I know" rule; (2) a platform profile of at least five lines, each backed by the tool's documentation (give links); (3) a learning path of five to ten steps, listing the concepts each adds; (4) your first real exchange: the prompt, the reply, and a line-by-line reading noting what fits your profile and what doesn't.
tasks.answer: Grade on: a complete profile with the core rule and clearly separated scaffolding/habits; accurate, documented platform profile lines; a sensible ordered path; a careful critical reading of the first reply. Replies vary, so grade the reasoning and care.
